title: Learn path
subtitle: Progressive chapters from first tones to QSO copy.

chapterDesc.orientation: Meet dots and dashes. Check volume. Copy a couple of letters.
chapterDesc.firstSounds: Koch start — K M R S U with listen and choose, then type.
chapterDesc.alphabet: Add characters two at a time until the letters are solid.
chapterDesc.numbers: Digits and punctuation join the mix.
chapterDesc.words: Real words in your language at Farnsworth spacing.
chapterDesc.ham: Prosigns AR SK BT KN used on the air.
chapterDesc.qso: Short scripted QSOs with conventional abbreviations.
chapterDesc.hero: Sustained accuracy at your target speed.

lessons.orientation2: Dot and dash — E and T
lessons.koch03: K M R S U — type to copy

demoHint: Press Play to hear the tone. A short mark is a dot; a long mark is a dash.
introLead: Listen to each new character, then start the questions.
introListen: Play {{letter}}, then continue when it is in your ear.
introOneDot: {{letter}} is a single short mark — a dot.
introOneDash: {{letter}} is a single long mark — a dash.
restartConfirm: Clear lesson progress and start the path from the first lesson? Character stats and sessions will be erased. Audio settings are kept.
